en.headline: Trump administration increases legal actions against US states
en.body: The administration is intensifying legal action against states before the midterm election, according to Reuters and The Straits Times. These elections will decide the balance of power in Washington for the final two years of the term, The Straits Times reported.

es.headline: El gobierno de Trump incrementa las acciones legales contra estados de EE. UU.
es.body: La administración está intensificando las acciones legales contra los estados antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato, según Reuters y The Straits Times. Estas elecciones decidirán el equilibrio de poder en Washington durante los dos últimos años del mandato, informó The Straits Times.

de.headline: Trump-Administration intensiviert rechtliche Schritte gegen US-Bundesstaaten
de.body: Die Regierung verschärft laut Reuters und The Straits Times die rechtlichen Maßnahmen gegen einzelne Bundesstaaten vor den Zwischenwahlen. Diese Wahlen werden über das Machtgefüge in Washington für die letzten zwei Jahre der Amtszeit entscheiden, berichtete The Straits Times.

fr.headline: L'administration Trump intensifie les actions en justice contre les États américains
fr.body: L'administration intensifie les actions en justice contre les États avant les élections de mi-mandat, selon Reuters et The Straits Times. Ces élections décideront de l'équilibre des pouvoirs à Washington pour les deux dernières années du mandat, a rapporté The Straits Times.

zh.headline: 特朗普政府加大对美国各州的法律行动
zh.body: 据路透社和《海峡时报》报道，该政府正在中期选举前加强针对各州的法律行动。《海峡时报》报道称，此次选举将决定任期最后两年的华盛顿权力平衡。

it.headline: L'amministrazione Trump intensifica le azioni legali contro gli stati USA
it.body: L'amministrazione sta intensificando le azioni legali contro gli stati prima delle elezioni di metà mandato, secondo Reuters e The Straits Times. Queste elezioni decideranno l'equilibrio del potere a Washington per gli ultimi due anni del mandato, ha riportato The Straits Times.

pt.headline: Administração Trump intensifica ações judiciais contra estados dos EUA
pt.body: A administração está a intensificar as ações judiciais contra os estados antes das eleições de meio de mandato, de acordo com a Reuters e o The Straits Times. Estas eleições decidirão o equilíbrio de poder em Washington nos últimos dois anos do mandato, reportou o The Straits Times.

ko.headline: 트럼프 행정부, 미국 주 정부 대상 법적 조치 확대
ko.body: 로이터 통신과 스트레이츠 타임스에 따르면, 행정부가 중간선거를 앞두고 주 정부들에 대한 법적 조치를 강화하고 있다. 스트레이츠 타임스는 이번 선거가 임기 마지막 2년 동안 워싱턴의 권력 균형을 결정짓게 될 것이라고 보도했다.

ja.headline: トランプ政権、米各州への法的措置を強化
ja.body: ロイターおよびストレイツ・タイムズによると、トランプ政権は中間選挙を前に各州への法的措置を強めている。ストレイツ・タイムズは、これらの中間選挙が任期最終2年間のワシントンの権力バランスを決定づけることになると報じた。

en.headline: Trump and Vance cancel campaign appearances
en.body: Donald Trump and JD Vance canceled planned appearances across three states, according to CNBC. This reduces in-person campaigning in the final days before the midterm elections, the outlet reported.

es.headline: Trump y Vance cancelan apariciones de campaña
es.body: Donald Trump y JD Vance cancelaron apariciones previstas en tres estados, según CNBC. Esto reduce la campaña presencial en los últimos días antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato, informó el medio.

de.headline: Trump und Vance sagen Wahlkampfauftritte ab
de.body: Donald Trump und JD Vance haben geplante Auftritte in drei Bundesstaaten abgesagt, so CNBC. Dies reduziere den persönlichen Wahlkampf in den letzten Tagen vor den Zwischenwahlen, berichtete das Medium.

fr.headline: Trump et Vance annulent des apparitions de campagne
fr.body: Donald Trump et JD Vance ont annulé des apparitions prévues dans trois États, selon CNBC. Cela réduit la campagne en personne dans les derniers jours précédant les élections de mi-mandat, a rapporté le média.

zh.headline: 特朗普与万斯取消竞选活动行程
zh.body: 据CNBC报道，唐纳德·特朗普和JD·万斯取消了在三个州的计划行程。该媒体报道称，这减少了中期选举前最后几天的面对面竞选活动。

it.headline: Trump e Vance annullano le apparizioni in campagna elettorale
it.body: Donald Trump e JD Vance hanno annullato le apparizioni previste in tre stati, secondo CNBC. Ciò riduce la campagna elettorale in presenza negli ultimi giorni prima delle elezioni di metà mandato, ha riportato la testata.

pt.headline: Trump e Vance cancelam aparições de campanha
pt.body: Donald Trump e JD Vance cancelaram aparições planeadas em três estados, segundo a CNBC. Isto reduz a campanha presencial nos dias finais antes das eleições de meio de mandato, reportou o meio de comunicação.

ko.headline: 트럼프와 밴스, 선거 유세 일정 취소
ko.body: CNBC에 따르면 도널드 트럼프와 JD 밴스가 3개 주에서 예정되었던 유세 일정을 취소했다. 해당 매체는 이로 인해 중간선거를 앞둔 마지막 며칠 동안의 대면 유세가 줄어들게 되었다고 보도했다.

ja.headline: トランプ氏とヴァンス氏、選挙キャンペーンへの出席をキャンセル
ja.body: CNBCによると、ドナルド・トランプ氏とJD・ヴァンス氏は3州で予定していた出席をキャンセルした。同メディアは、これにより中間選挙直前の数日間における対面での選挙活動が減少すると報じた。

en.headline: Donald Trump cancels two campaign rallies
en.body: President Donald Trump cancelled rallies in Kansas and Iowa, according to Al Jazeera and Dawn. The Republican Party stated he will instead hold telephone events across nearly 20 states over the weekend.

de.headline: Donald Trump sagt zwei Wahlkampfveranstaltungen ab
de.body: Präsident Donald Trump hat Kundgebungen in Kansas und Iowa abgesagt, wie Al Jazeera und Dawn berichten. Die Republikanische Partei gab bekannt, dass er stattdessen am Wochenende Telefonveranstaltungen in fast 20 Bundesstaaten abhalten wird.

fr.headline: Donald Trump annule deux meetings de campagne
fr.body: Le président Donald Trump a annulé des meetings au Kansas et en Iowa, selon Al Jazeera et Dawn. Le Parti républicain a déclaré qu'il organisera à la place des événements téléphoniques dans près de 20 États ce week-end.

es.headline: Donald Trump cancela dos mítines de campaña
es.body: El presidente Donald Trump canceló mítines en Kansas e Iowa, según Al Jazeera y Dawn. El Partido Republicano afirmó que, en su lugar, llevará a cabo eventos telefónicos en casi 20 estados durante el fin de semana.

it.headline: Donald Trump annulla due comizi elettorali
it.body: Il presidente Donald Trump ha annullato i comizi in Kansas e Iowa, secondo Al Jazeera e Dawn. Il Partito Repubblicano ha dichiarato che terrà invece eventi telefonici in quasi 20 stati durante il fine settimana.

pt.headline: Donald Trump cancela dois comícios de campanha
pt.body: O presidente Donald Trump cancelou comícios no Kansas e em Iowa, de acordo com a Al Jazeera e a Dawn. O Partido Republicano afirmou que ele realizará, em alternativa, eventos telefónicos em quase 20 estados durante o fim de semana.

zh.headline: 唐纳德·特朗普取消两场竞选集会
zh.body: 据半岛电视台和《黎明报》报道，总统唐纳德·特朗普取消了在堪萨斯州和爱荷华州的集会。共和党表示，他将在周末改为在近20个州举行电话活动。

ko.headline: 도널드 트럼프, 선거 유세 집회 두 곳 취소
ko.body: 알자지라와 던의 보도에 따르면 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 캔자스와 아이오와에서 예정된 유세 집회를 취소했다. 공화당은 그가 대신 이번 주말 동안 약 20개 주에서 전화 행사를 개최할 것이라고 밝혔다.

ja.headline: ドナルド・トランプ氏、選挙集会2件をキャンセル
ja.body: アルジャジーラとドーンの報道によると、ドナルド・トランプ大統領はカンザス州とアイオワ州での集会をキャンセルした。共和党は、同氏が代わりに週末にかけて20近い州で電話イベントを開催すると発表した。

en.body: The Department of Justice issued subpoenas regarding a Democratic plan to recruit a spoiler candidate in Alaska, according to the New York Times and CNBC. The state has also opened its own inquiry into the matter.

de.headline: Justizministerium erlässt Vorladungen zum Senatswahlkampf in Alaska
de.body: Das Justizministerium hat Vorladungen im Zusammenhang mit einem Plan der Demokraten zur Rekrutierung eines strategischen Drittkandidaten in Alaska erlassen, berichten die New York Times und CNBC. Der Bundesstaat hat zudem eine eigene Untersuchung zu der Angelegenheit eingeleitet.

fr.headline: Le ministère de la Justice émet des assignations concernant la course au Sénat en Alaska
fr.body: Le ministère de la Justice a émis des assignations concernant un plan démocrate visant à recruter un candidat perturbateur en Alaska, selon le New York Times et CNBC. L'État a également ouvert sa propre enquête sur l'affaire.

es.headline: El Departamento de Justicia emite citaciones sobre la contienda al Senado en Alaska
es.body: El Departamento de Justicia emitió citaciones relacionadas con un plan demócrata para reclutar a un candidato disruptor en Alaska, según el New York Times y CNBC. El estado también ha abierto su propia investigación sobre el asunto.

it.headline: Il Dipartimento di Giustizia emette citazioni sulla corsa al Senato in Alaska
it.body: Il Dipartimento di Giustizia ha emesso citazioni riguardanti un piano democratico per reclutare un candidato terzo in Alaska, secondo il New York Times e CNBC. Lo stato ha inoltre aperto un'indagine propria sulla questione.

pt.headline: Departamento de Justiça emite intimações sobre corrida ao Senado no Alasca
pt.body: O Departamento de Justiça emitiu intimações relativas a um plano democrata para recrutar um candidato estratégico no Alasca, segundo o New York Times e a CNBC. O estado também abriu a sua própria investigação sobre o assunto.

zh.headline: 司法部就阿拉斯加参议院选举发出传票
zh.body: 据《纽约时报》和CNBC报道，司法部就民主党在阿拉斯加招募搅局候选人的计划发出了传票。该州也已就此事展开独立调查。

ko.headline: 법무부, 알래스카 상원 선거 관련 소환장 발부
ko.body: 뉴욕타임스와 CNBC에 따르면 법무부는 알래스카에서 표심을 분산시킬 후보를 영입하려 한 민주당의 계획과 관련해 소환장을 발부했다. 해당 주 정부 또한 이 문제에 대해 자체 조사에 착수했다.

ja.headline: 司法省、アラスカ州上院議員選を巡り召喚状を発行
ja.body: ニューヨーク・タイムズとCNBCによると、司法省はアラスカ州で民主党が票を割るための候補者を擁立しようとした計画に関して召喚状を発行した。同州もまた、この件について独自の調査を開始している。

en.title: Justice Department subpoenas Alaska Senate race as Trump cancels rallies and appearances
en.dek: The DOJ issued subpoenas in the Alaska Senate contest, while Donald Trump and JD Vance canceled in-person events and the administration expanded legal actions against states before the midterm election.
facts: The Justice Department issued subpoenas about a Democratic effort to recruit a spoiler candidate in Alaska's Senate race (NYT, CNBC).
Alaska state officials opened a parallel inquiry into the alleged spoiler recruitment (NYT).
President Donald Trump cancelled rallies in Kansas and Iowa (Al Jazeera, Dawn).
The Republican Party announced telephone events in nearly 20 states to replace the cancelled rallies (Al Jazeera).
Donald Trump and JD Vance cancelled planned campaign appearances in three states (CNBC).
The Trump administration increased legal actions against states before the election (Reuters, The Straits Times).
body: Donald Trump and JD Vance cancelled planned campaign appearances in three states, according to CNBC.
The cancellations occurred on the same day that the election weekend approached, and they reduced in‑person outreach for both candidates, CNBC reported.
CNBC reported the decision as part of a broader shift in campaign strategy.
The Justice Department issued subpoenas concerning a Democratic plan to recruit a spoiler candidate in the Alaska Senate race, according to the New York Times and CNBC.
The subpoenas target communications that the department says relate to ballot‑packing efforts, the outlets reported.
The action follows federal interest in election integrity, the reports noted.
Alaska state officials opened a separate inquiry into the alleged Democratic spoiler recruitment, according to the New York Times.
The state investigation runs parallel to the federal subpoenas, and officials said it will examine any coordination with third‑party candidates, the newspaper reported.
The inquiry focuses on potential violations of state election law, the report added.
President Donald Trump cancelled scheduled rallies in Kansas and Iowa, Al Jazeera and Dawn reported.
The president announced that telephone events would replace the rallies, and the Republican Party said the calls would reach nearly 20 states over the weekend, Al Jazeera noted.
The shift aims to maintain voter contact despite the cancellations, the outlet added.
The Trump administration increased legal actions against states ahead of the election, Reuters and The Straits Times reported.
The actions include lawsuits challenging state election rules, and officials said they are intended to protect voting integrity, the sources said.
The moves come as the midterm campaign intensifies, the reports observed.
The 2026 midterm elections will decide control of Congress and several governorships, Al Jazeera reported.
These contests occur amid heightened scrutiny of campaign tactics, and the recent Alaska and Trump developments illustrate the complex environment, the outlet noted.
Observers note the legal and procedural battles could influence voter perceptions, Al Jazeera added.
en.context: Al Jazeera reported that the 2026 United States midterm elections will determine control of Congress and several state offices. The elections are occurring as federal and state authorities examine campaign practices, highlighted by the Alaska Senate investigation and the administration’s legal actions.

en.title: Justice Department subpoenas Alaska Senate race; Trump cancels two rallies
en.dek: The DOJ issued subpoenas in Alaska's Senate contest while President Trump called off weekend rallies in Kansas and Iowa, opting for telephone events in nearly 20 states.
facts: The Justice Department issued subpoenas related to a Democratic plan to recruit a spoiler candidate in the Alaska Senate race (NYT, CNBC).
Alaska state officials opened their own inquiry into the alleged spoiler recruitment (NYT).
President Donald Trump cancelled rallies in Kansas and Iowa (Al Jazeera, Dawn).
The Republican Party said Trump will hold telephone events across nearly 20 states over the weekend (Al Jazeera).
body: President Donald Trump cancelled rallies in Kansas and Iowa, according to Al Jazeera and Dawn. The Republican Party said he will instead hold telephone events across nearly 20 states over the weekend, as reported by Al Jazeera.

The Justice Department issued subpoenas concerning a Democratic plan to recruit a spoiler candidate in the Alaska Senate race, according to the New York Times and CNBC. The subpoenas target communications related to the alleged ballot‑packing strategy.

The Republican Party announced that the telephone events will replace the cancelled rallies, covering almost 20 states, per Al Jazeera. Party officials indicated the shift aims to maintain voter outreach despite the rally cancellations.
Alaska state officials opened their own inquiry into the alleged Democratic spoiler recruitment, as noted by the New York Times. The state investigation runs parallel to the federal subpoena action.

The investigation described a Democratic effort to coordinate with a third‑party candidate to split the Republican vote in the Senate contest, according to the New York Times. The plan allegedly involved communications with the potential spoiler, which the DOJ subpoenas seek to examine.

The 2026 midterm elections include contests for the Senate, House and governorships nationwide, as reported by Al Jazeera. These races are occurring amid heightened scrutiny of campaign tactics, highlighted by the recent Alaska and Trump developments.
en.context: The 2026 United States midterm elections determine control of Congress and several state offices, according to Al Jazeera. Alaska's Senate seat is a focal point after allegations of a Democratic ballot‑packing scheme, as reported by the New York Times.

de.title: Justizministerium fordert Unterlagen zum Senatswahlkampf in Alaska an; Trump sagt zwei Kundgebungen ab
de.dek: Das Justizministerium hat Vorladungen im Zusammenhang mit dem Senatswahlkampf in Alaska erlassen, während Präsident Trump die Wochenendkundgebungen in Kansas und Iowa absagte und sich stattdessen für Telefonveranstaltungen in fast 20 Bundesstaaten entschied.
facts: Das Justizministerium hat Vorladungen im Zusammenhang mit einem Plan der Demokraten erlassen, einen strategischen Scheinbewerber für den Senatswahlkampf in Alaska zu rekrutieren (NYT, CNBC).
Beamte des Bundesstaates Alaska haben eine eigene Untersuchung zur mutmaßlichen Rekrutierung des Scheinbewerbers eingeleitet (NYT).
Präsident Donald Trump sagte Kundgebungen in Kansas und Iowa ab (Al Jazeera, Dawn).
Die Republikanische Partei teilte mit, dass Trump am Wochenende Telefonveranstaltungen in fast 20 Bundesstaaten abhalten wird (Al Jazeera).
body: Präsident Donald Trump sagte Kundgebungen in Kansas und Iowa ab, so Al Jazeera und Dawn. Die Republikanische Partei gab bekannt, dass er stattdessen am Wochenende Telefonveranstaltungen in fast 20 Bundesstaaten abhalten wird, wie Al Jazeera berichtete.

Das Justizministerium hat Vorladungen bezüglich eines Plans der Demokraten erlassen, einen strategischen Scheinbewerber für den Senatswahlkampf in Alaska zu rekrutieren, laut New York Times und CNBC. Die Vorladungen richten sich gegen die Kommunikation im Zusammenhang mit der mutmaßlichen Strategie zur Manipulation der Stimmzettel.

Die Republikanische Partei kündigte an, dass die Telefonveranstaltungen die abgesagten Kundgebungen ersetzen und fast 20 Bundesstaaten abdecken werden, laut Al Jazeera. Parteifunktionäre gaben an, dass dieser Wechsel darauf abzielt, die Wähleransprache trotz der abgesagten Kundgebungen aufrechtzuerhalten.

Beamte des Bundesstaates Alaska haben eine eigene Untersuchung zur mutmaßlichen Rekrutierung eines Scheinbewerbers durch die Demokraten eingeleitet, wie die New York Times vermerkte. Die staatliche Untersuchung läuft parallel zu den Vorladungen auf Bundesebene.

Die Untersuchung beschrieb eine Bemühung der Demokraten, sich mit einem Drittkandidaten abzustimmen, um die republikanischen Stimmen im Senatswahlkampf zu spalten, laut New York Times. Der Plan beinhaltete mutmaßlich Kommunikation mit dem potenziellen Scheinbewerber, die durch die Vorladungen des Justizministeriums geprüft werden soll.

Die Zwischenwahlen 2026 umfassen landesweit Kämpfe um Sitze im Senat, im Repräsentantenhaus sowie Gouverneursposten, wie Al Jazeera berichtete. Diese Rennen finden inmitten einer verschärften Prüfung von Kampagnentaktiken statt, was durch die jüngsten Entwicklungen in Alaska und bei Trump verdeutlicht wird.
de.context: Die Zwischenwahlen 2026 in den Vereinigten Staaten entscheiden über die Kontrolle des Kongresses und mehrerer Ämter in den Bundesstaaten, laut Al Jazeera. Der Senatssitz von Alaska steht nach Vorwürfen über ein System der Stimmzettelmanipulation durch die Demokraten im Fokus, wie die New York Times berichtete.
